entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with VeloFit support, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to return something. It's the... uh... VeloBand Pulse that I bought a couple of weeks ago.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. I just... I guess I changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy and to be honest, I just don't use it.
I understand. Thanks for clarifying that for me. Let me just pull up your order details... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 16 days ago, on January 1st.
Yes, that sounds about right. So how do I send it back?

Well, because the VeloBand Pulse is a wellness device that activates and links to a user's personal account, it has a specific 10-day return window. Since we are now on day 16, I'm afraid we're outside the period where I can process a return for a refund.
Wait, 10 days? I... I didn't see that. The website was so confusing, I thought it was much longer. Can't you just help me? It's practically brand new, I really won't ever use it.

I can definitely appreciate your frustration, and I do want to find a good solution for you. While a direct return to VeloFit isn't an option at this point, we do have a program that many of our customers in your exact situation find very helpful.

We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a secure platform where you can sell your device directly to another member of the VeloFit community. It's a great way to ensure the band goes to someone who will use it, and you can recoup your cost.
A resale marketplace? So... I sell it myself?

Exactly. We provide the secure platform and access to buyers who are specifically looking for VeloFit gear. Since your band is in like-new condition, it will likely sell very quickly. It's a much better outcome than having it sit in a drawer. I'd be happy to email you a direct link with a guide on how to create a listing.
Oh. Okay, that actually sounds like a good idea. At least it's something. Yes, please send me that link.
Of course. I've just sent that email to the address we have on file. It should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
